+ import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
+ import { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';
+ import { SavedJobsService, SavedJob } from '../../utilities/savedJobsService';
+ import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
+ import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
+ import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
+ 
+ const SavedJobsPage: React.FC = () =&gt; {
+   const { currentUser } = useAuth();
+   const [savedJobs, setSavedJobs] = useState&lt;SavedJob[]&gt;([]);
+   const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     const fetchSavedJobs = async () =&gt; {
+       if (!currentUser) return;
+       setIsLoading(true);
+       try {
+         const jobs = await SavedJobsService.getSavedJobsWithData(currentUser.uid);
+         setSavedJobs(jobs);
+       } catch (error) {
+         console.error('Error loading saved jobs:', error);
+         toast.error('Failed to load saved jobs');
+       } finally {
+         setIsLoading(false);
+       }
+     };
+     if (currentUser) fetchSavedJobs();
+   }, [currentUser]);
+ 
+   const handleRemove = async (savedJobId: string) =&gt; {
+     try {
+       await SavedJobsService.removeSavedJob(savedJobId);
+       setSavedJobs(prev =&gt; prev.filter(job =&gt; job.id !== savedJobId));
+       toast.success('Job removed from saved list');
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('Error removing saved job:', error);
+       toast.error('Failed to remove saved job');
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 py-12 px-4 md:px-8"&gt;
+       &lt;div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto"&gt;
+         &lt;div className="mb-8 flex items-center justify-between"&gt;
+           &lt;h1 className="text-3xl font-light text-gray-900"&gt;Saved Jobs&lt;/h1&gt;
+           &lt;Link to="/jobs" className="text-blue-600 hover:underline text-sm"&gt;← Back to Job Search&lt;/Link&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+         {isLoading ? (
+           &lt;div className="text-center py-12"&gt;
+             &lt;div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-gray-900 mx-auto mb-4"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;p className="text-lg font-light text-gray-600"&gt;Loading saved jobs...&lt;/p&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         ) : savedJobs.length === 0 ? (
+           &lt;div className="text-center py-12"&gt;
+             &lt;div className="text-6xl mb-4 opacity-20"&gt;💾&lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;h3 className="text-xl font-light text-gray-900 mb-2"&gt;No saved jobs yet&lt;/h3&gt;
+             &lt;p className="text-gray-600"&gt;Jobs you save will appear here.&lt;/p&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         ) : (
+           &lt;div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6"&gt;
+             {savedJobs.map(({ id, jobData }) =&gt; (
+               &lt;div key={id} className="bg-white border border-gray-100 rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6 flex flex-col justify-between"&gt;
+                 &lt;div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
+                   &lt;Link to={jobData ? &#96;/jobs/${jobData.id}&#96; : '#'} className="text-lg font-medium text-gray-900 hover:text-blue-600 transition-colors truncate" title={jobData?.title}&gt;
+                     {jobData?.title || 'Untitled Job'}
+                   &lt;/Link&gt;
+                   {jobData?.status &amp;&amp; (

_**Agent (2025-07-20 17:31:24Z)**_

Thank you for the detailed error report.  
The error:

```
Error responding to follow request: Error: Follow request not found
    at SocialService.respondToFollowRequest (socialService.ts:88:1)
    at async handleFollowRequest (SocialPage.tsx:263:1)
```

means that when you click "Accept" on a friend/follow request, the code tries to update a Firestore document in the `followRequests` collection, but **the document with that ID does not exist**.

---

## **Why This Happens**

- The UI is passing a request ID (from the local state) to `SocialService.respondToFollowRequest`.
- The backend tries to fetch that document from Firestore:  
  `const requestRef = doc(db, 'followRequests', requestId);`
- But Firestore returns "not found" for that ID.

### **Possible Causes**
1. **The request was already accepted/rejected/deleted** (by you or the other user, or in another tab).
2. **The local state is out of sync** with Firestore (e.g., the UI shows a request that no longer exists).
3. **The wrong ID is being passed** (e.g., the UI is using the user ID instead of the request document ID).
4. **The request was never created in Firestore** (bug in sending logic).

---

## **How to Fix**

### **Step 1: Confirm the ID**
- The `handleFollowRequest` function should pass the **Firestore document ID** of the follow request, not the user ID.

### **Step 2: Ensure UI State is in Sync**
- The list of requests (`connectionRequests` or `followRequests`) should be loaded from Firestore and use the correct IDs.

### **Step 3: Defensive UI**
- If the request is not found, remove it from the UI and show a message.

---

## **Let’s Check the Code**

From your previous code, in `SocialPage.tsx`:

```ts
const handleFollowRequest = async (userId: string, action: 'accept' | 'reject') => {
  // Find the follow request for this user
  const request = connectionRequests.find(p => getProfileId(p) === userId);
  if (!request) return;
  try {
    await SocialService.respondToFollowRequest(request.id, action === 'accept' ? 'accepted' : 'rejected');
    // ...
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`Error ${action}ing follow request:`, error);
    // Optionally show error to user
  }
};
```

- **If `getProfileId(p)` returns the user ID, but `request.id` is not the Firestore document ID, this will fail.**
- The `id` property in the request object **must be the Firestore document ID** of the follow request.

---

## **Action Plan**

1. **Check how `connectionRequests` is populated.**  
   - Ensure each request object has an `id` property that matches the Firestore document ID.
2. **Check the data structure of requests in Firestore.**
3. **Add a debug log to print the request object and ID before calling `respondToFollowRequest`.**
4. **If the ID is wrong, fix the mapping.**

---

I will check how `connectionRequests` is populated in `SocialPage.tsx`.

        "originalContents": "\n        \n        const realSentRequests = await outgoingRequestsPromise;\n        const mappedSentRequests = await Promise.all(\n          realSentRequests.map(async (req: any) =\u003e {\n            const userProfile = await fetchUserProfile(req.toUserId);\n            return userProfile;\n          })\n        );\n        setSentRequests(mappedSentRequests);\n        \n      } catch (socialError) {\n        console.log('Social data loading (expected for new users):', socialError);\n        // For new users, these should be empty\n        setConnectionRequests([]);\n        setSentRequests([]);\n        setConnections([]);\n      }\n      \n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading profiles:', error);\n      // Clear all data on error\n      setAllProfiles([]);\n      setFilteredProfiles([]);\n      setConnectionRequests([]);\n      setSentRequests([]);\n      setConnections([]);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [auth]);\n\n  // Load data on component mount and when active tab changes\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    // Clear the user cache to ensure new logic takes effect\n    const clearCache = async () =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const { UserUtils } = await import('../utilities/userUtils');\n        UserUtils.refreshUserCache();\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error clearing user cache:', error);\n      }\n    };\n    clearCache();\n    \n    loadData();\n  }, [activeTab, user?.uid]);",

        "contents": "const SocialPage =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  // Handle follow request response (accept/reject)\n  const handleFollowRequest = async (userId: string, action: 'accept' | 'reject') =\u003e {\n    // Find the follow request for this user\n    const request = connectionRequests.find(p =\u003e getProfileId(p) === userId);\n    if (!request) return;\n    try {\n      await SocialService.respondToFollowRequest(request.id, action === 'accept' ? 'accepted' : 'rejected');\n      // Update local state after backend call\n      if (action === 'accept') {\n        setConnections(prev =\u003e [...prev, request]);\n      }\n      setConnectionRequests(prev =\u003e prev.filter(p =\u003e getProfileId(p) !== userId));\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(&#96;Error ${action}ing follow request:&#96;, error);\n      // Optionally show error to user\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Messaging functions\n  const loadConversations = useCallback(async () =\u003e {\n    if (!user?.uid) return;\n    \n    const unsubscribe = MessagingService.subscribeToConversations(\n      user.uid,\n      (conversations) =\u003e {\n        setConversations(conversations);\n      }\n    );\n\n    return unsubscribe;\n  }, [user?.uid]);\n\n  const handleStartConversation = (userId: string) =\u003e {\n    if (!userId) {\n      setShowStartConversation(true);\n      setShowMessagePane(false);\n    } else {\n      // Navigate to chat or open chat interface\n      setShowMessagePane(false);\n      setShowStartConversation(false);\n      console.log('Starting conversation with:', userId);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatTime = (date?: Date) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return '';\n    const now = new Date();\n    const diff = now.getTime() - date.getTime();\n    const days = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));\n    \n    if (days === 0) {\n      return date.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });\n    } else if (days === 1) {\n      return 'Yesterday';\n    } else if (days \u003c 7) {\n      return date.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: 'short' });\n    } else {\n      return date.toLocaleDateString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  // Filter profiles based on search query and active tab\n  const filteredItems = useMemo(() =\u003e {\n    const items = {\n      connections: [...connections],\n      requests: [...connectionRequests, ...sentRequests],\n      discover: [...filteredProfiles],\n      notifications: []\n    }[activeTab] || [];\n\n    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return items;\n\n    const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();\n    return items.filter((p) =\u003e {\n      const name = getDisplayName(p).toLowerCase();\n      const bio = p.bio ? p.bio.toLowerCase() : '';\n      return name.includes(query) || bio.includes(query);\n    });\n  }, [activeTab, connections, connectionRequests, sentRequests, filteredProfiles, searchQuery]);\n\n  const handleSearchChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent\u003cHTMLInputElement\u003e) =\u003e {\n    setSearchQuery(e.target.value);\n  };\n\n  // Handle tab change\n  const handleTabChange = (value: 'connections' | 'requests' | 'discover' | 'notifications') =\u003e {\n    setActiveTab(value);\n    setSearchQuery('');\n  };\n\n  // Handle follow/unfollow action\n  const handleFollowChange = async (profileId: string, follow: boolean) =\u003e {\n    if (!user?.uid) return;\n    \n    try {\n      if (follow) {\n        await SocialService.sendFollowRequest(user.uid, profileId);\n      } else {\n        await SocialService.unfollow(user.uid, profileId);\n      }\n      await loadData();\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error updating follow status:', error);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  // Start Conversation Modal Component\n  const StartConversationModal = () =\u003e {\n    if (!showStartConversation) return null;\n\n    const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState\u003cAppProfile[]\u003e([]);\n    const [isSearching, setIsSearching] = useState(false);\n\n    const searchUsers = useCallback(async (query: string) =\u003e {\n      if (!query.trim() || !user?.uid) {\n        setSearchResults([]);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      setIsSearching(true);\n      try {\n        // Search through connections and discover profiles\n        const allUsers = [...connections, ...filteredProfiles];\n        const filtered = allUsers.filter(profile =\u003e \n          getProfileId(profile) !== user.uid \u0026\u0026\n          (profile.displayName?.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||\n           (profile as any).name?.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||\n           (profile as any).email?.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()))\n        );\n\n        setSearchResults(filtered.slice(0, 10));\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error searching users:', error);\n        setSearchResults([]);\n      } finally {\n        setIsSearching(false);\n      }\n    }, [connections, filteredProfiles, user?.uid]);\n\n    useEffect(() =\u003e {\n      const timeoutId = setTimeout(() =\u003e {\n        searchUsers(messageSearchQuery);\n      }, 300);\n\n      return () =\u003e clearTimeout(timeoutId);\n    }, [messageSearchQuery, searchUsers]);",

_**Agent**_

**Root cause found:**  
Your `connectionRequests` array in `SocialPage.tsx` is populated with user profile objects (from `crewProfiles`), **not the actual follow request Firestore documents**.  
So when you try to accept a request, you pass the user’s UID (or a profile object) to `respondToFollowRequest`, but that function expects the Firestore document ID of the follow request in the `followRequests` collection.

---

## **How to Fix**

### **Step 1: Store the Firestore Follow Request Document ID**
- When you load follow requests (via `SocialService.subscribeToFollowRequests`), you get an array of `FollowRequest` objects, each with an `id` (the Firestore doc ID).
- When you map these to user profiles, **attach the request ID to the profile object** (e.g., as `requestId`).

### **Step 2: Use the Correct ID When Accepting/Rejecting**
- When calling `respondToFollowRequest`, use `profile.requestId` (not `profile.id` or `profile.uid`).

---

## **What to Change**

- In your `loadData` function, when mapping follow requests to profiles, do:
  ```js
  const mappedRequests = await Promise.all(
    realFollowRequests.map(async (req: any) => {
      const userProfile = await fetchUserProfile(req.fromUserId);
      return { ...userProfile, requestId: req.id }; // Attach the Firestore request ID
    })
  );
  setConnectionRequests(mappedRequests);
  ```
- In `handleFollowRequest`, use `request.requestId`:
  ```js
  const request = connectionRequests.find(p => getProfileId(p) === userId);
  if (!request) return;
  await SocialService.respondToFollowRequest(request.requestId, action === 'accept' ? 'accepted' : 'rejected');
  ```

---

**Would you like me to apply this fix to `SocialPage.tsx` now?**  
This will resolve the "Follow request not found" error and make friend request acceptance work as expected.

_**Agent**_

Thank you for the detailed context and for pointing out that the friend request functionality worked in the past. Based on your request, I checked the old commit and the current code, and here’s what I found:

---

## **Root Cause:**
- **Previously:** The friend/follow request acceptance logic used the Firestore document ID of the follow request (from the `followRequests` collection).
- **Currently:** The UI is passing the user’s UID (from the profile) instead of the Firestore document ID to the acceptance function, which causes the backend to fail with “Follow request not found.”

---

## **How It Was Handled Before:**
- The `connectionRequests` array was populated with objects that included both the user profile and the actual follow request document ID (e.g., as `requestId` or `id`).
- When accepting/rejecting, the code used the Firestore document ID, not the user’s UID.

---

## **How to Fix:**
1. **When loading follow requests, attach the Firestore document ID to the profile object** (e.g., as `requestId`).
2. **When accepting/rejecting a request, use `request.requestId`** (not `request.id` or `request.uid`).

---

## **Action Plan:**
- Update the mapping in your `loadData` function in `SocialPage.tsx`:
  ```js
  const mappedRequests = await Promise.all(
    realFollowRequests.map(async (req: any) => {
      const userProfile = await fetchUserProfile(req.fromUserId);
      return { ...userProfile, requestId: req.id }; // Attach the Firestore request ID
    })
  );
  setConnectionRequests(mappedRequests);
  ```
- Update `handleFollowRequest` to use `request.requestId`:
  ```js
  const request = connectionRequests.find(p => getProfileId(p) === userId);
  if (!request) return;
  await SocialService.respondToFollowRequest(request.requestId, action === 'accept' ? 'accepted' : 'rejected');
  ```

---

**Would you like me to apply this fix to your current code?**  
This will restore the original, working friend request acceptance logic and resolve the “Follow request not found” error.

- **Why:** Users can only view saved jobs if they have a way to save them! Many job boards have a “Save” or “Bookmark” icon on each job card and job detail page.
- **How:**  
  - Add a “Save” (star/bookmark) button to each job card and the job detail page.
  - Use `SavedJobsService.isJobSaved` to show the correct state (saved/unsaved).
  - Clicking toggles save/remove, with instant UI feedback.

---

## 2. **Add Toast Notifications for All Key Actions**

- **Why:** Users should get instant feedback when they save a job, apply, accept a friend request, etc.
- **How:**  
  - Use `react-hot-toast` for all major actions (save, unsave, apply, accept/reject request, etc.).
  - Ensure error toasts are clear and actionable.

---

## 3. **Modernize and Unify Card UI/UX**

- **Why:** Consistency and polish make the app feel professional and trustworthy.
- **How:**  
  - Use the Crew Card style as a model for all cards (jobs, applicants, saved jobs, etc.).
  - Add hover effects, status badges, and quick actions.
  - Ensure all cards are responsive and accessible.

---

## 4. **Add Real-Time Updates for Job Applications and Saved Jobs**

- **Why:** Users expect to see changes reflected instantly (e.g., if they save a job in one tab, it should appear in “Saved Jobs” in another).
- **How:**  
  - Use the `subscribeToSavedJobs` and similar real-time listeners for applications and saved jobs.
  - Update UI state in real time.

---

## 5. **Enhance Job Application Status Tracking**

- **Why:** Applicants want to know the status of their applications (pending, reviewed, shortlisted, etc.).
- **How:**  
  - Show status badges on the “Applied Jobs” page.
  - Optionally, add a timeline or progress bar for each application.

---

## 6. **Improve Social/Networking Features**

- **Why:** Social features are a key differentiator for your platform.
- **How:**  
  - Add “Message” buttons to Crew Cards and applicant lists.
  - Show mutual connections or shared projects on profiles.
  - Add notifications for new followers, accepted requests, etc.

---

## 7. **Accessibility and Mobile Responsiveness**

- **Why:** A modern app must be usable by everyone, everywhere.
- **How:**  
  - Audit all pages for keyboard navigation, ARIA labels, and color contrast.
  - Test and polish all layouts on mobile devices.

---

## 8. **Performance and Error Handling**

- **Why:** Fast, reliable apps keep users engaged.
- **How:**  
  - Add loading skeletons/placeholders for all async data.
  - Catch and display errors gracefully (not just in the console).

---

## **Which improvement would you like to tackle next?**
- “Save Job” button on job cards/details (recommended for immediate user value)
- Real-time updates for saved jobs/applications
- UI/UX polish and card consistency
- Social features (messaging, notifications)
- Accessibility/mobile improvements
- Something else?

'pending' : 'completed';\n    onStatusChange(task.id, newStatus);\n  };\n  \n  const formatDueDate = (dateValue?: string | Date | { toDate: () =\u003e Date } | null) =\u003e {\n    if (!dateValue) return null;\n    \n    let date: Date;\n    \n    try {\n      if (dateValue instanceof Date) {\n        date = dateValue;\n      } else if (typeof dateValue === 'object' \u0026\u0026 dateValue !== null \u0026\u0026 'toDate' in dateValue) {\n        // Handle Firestore Timestamp\n        date = dateValue.toDate();\n      } else if (typeof dateValue === 'string') {\n        date = new Date(dateValue);\n      } else {\n        console.warn('Unhandled date type:', typeof dateValue, dateValue);\n        return null;\n      }\n      \n      // Check if date is valid\n      if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return 'Invalid date';\n      \n      if (isToday(date)) return &#96;Today, ${format(date, 'h:mm a')}&#96;;\n      if (isTomorrow(date)) return &#96;Tomorrow, ${format(date, 'h:mm a')}&#96;;\n      if (isThisWeek(date)) return format(date, 'EEEE, h:mm a');\n      return format(date, 'MMM d, yyyy h:mm a');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error formatting date:', error);\n      return 'Invalid date';\n    }\n  };\n  \n  const isOverdue = task.dueDate \u0026\u0026 isPast(new Date(task.dueDate)) \u0026\u0026 task.status !== 'completed';\n\n  const priorityColor = priorityColors[task.priority as keyof typeof priorityColors] || priorityColors.low;\n  const statusColor = statusColors[task.status as keyof typeof statusColors] || statusColors.pending;\n  const statusIcon = statusIcons[task.status as keyof typeof statusIcons] || statusIcons.pending;",

'pending' : 'completed';\n    onStatusChange(task.id, newStatus);\n  };\n  \n  const formatDueDate = (dateValue?: string | Date | { toDate: () =\u003e Date } | null) =\u003e {\n    if (!dateValue) return null;\n    \n    let date: Date;\n    \n    try {\n      if (dateValue instanceof Date) {\n        date = dateValue;\n      } else if (typeof dateValue === 'object' \u0026\u0026 dateValue !== null \u0026\u0026 'toDate' in dateValue) {\n        // Handle Firestore Timestamp\n        date = dateValue.toDate();\n      } else if (typeof dateValue === 'string') {\n        date = new Date(dateValue);\n      } else {\n        console.warn('Unhandled date type:', typeof dateValue, dateValue);\n        return null;\n      }\n      \n      // Check if date is valid\n      if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return 'Invalid date';\n      \n      if (isToday(date)) return &#96;Today, ${format(date, 'h:mm a')}&#96;;\n      if (isTomorrow(date)) return &#96;Tomorrow, ${format(date, 'h:mm a')}&#96;;\n      if (isThisWeek(date)) return format(date, 'EEEE, h:mm a');\n      return format(date, 'MMM d, yyyy h:mm a');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error formatting date:', error);\n      return 'Invalid date';\n    }\n  };\n  \n  const isOverdue = task.dueDate \u0026\u0026 isPast(new Date(task.dueDate)) \u0026\u0026 task.status !== 'completed';\n\n  const priorityColor = priorityColors[task.priority as keyof typeof priorityColors] || priorityColors.low;\n  const statusColor = statusColors[task.status as keyof typeof statusColors] || statusColors.pending;\n  const statusIcon = statusIcons[task.status as keyof typeof statusIcons] || statusIcons.pending;",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "const ProjectCard: React.FC\u003cProjectCardProps\u003e =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  // Helper to format status text\n  const formatStatusText = (status: ProjectStatus) =\u003e {\n    switch (status) {\n      case 'in_production':\n      case 'production':\n        return 'In Production';\n      case 'pre_production':\n      case 'pre-production':\n        return 'Pre-Production';\n      case 'post_production':\n      case 'post-production':\n        return 'Post-Production';\n      case 'development':\n        return 'Development';\n      case 'completed':\n        return 'Completed';\n      case 'cancelled':\n        return 'Cancelled';\n      default:\n        return status ? status.replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/\\b\\w/g, c =\u003e c.toUpperCase()) : 'Unknown';\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    \u003cCard\n      className={&#96;bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300 flex flex-col ${className}&#96;}\n      style={{ padding: 20, minHeight: 340, maxWidth: 370, margin: 'auto', boxSizing: 'border-box' }}\n      hoverable\n      onClick={handleCardClick}\n      role=\"button\"\n      tabIndex={0}\n      aria-label={&#96;View details for ${projectName || 'Untitled Project'}&#96;}\n      onKeyDown={e =\u003e { \n        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {\n          e.preventDefault();\n          handleCardClick();\n        }\n      }}\n    \u003e\n      {/* Cover Image with subtle project name overlay */}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  // Helper to format status text\n  const formatStatusText = (status: ProjectStatus) =\u003e {\n    switch (status) {\n      case 'in_production':\n      case 'production':\n        return 'In Production';\n      case 'pre_production':\n      case 'pre-production':\n        return 'Pre-Production';\n      case 'post_production':\n      case 'post-production':\n        return 'Post-Production';\n      case 'development':\n        return 'Development';\n      case 'completed':\n        return 'Completed';\n      case 'cancelled':\n        return 'Cancelled';\n      default:\n        return status ? status.replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/\\b\\w/g, c =\u003e c.toUpperCase()) : 'Unknown';\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    \u003cCard\n      className={&#96;bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300 flex flex-col ${className}&#96;}\n      style={{ padding: 20, minHeight: 340, maxWidth: 370, margin: 'auto', boxSizing: 'border-box' }}\n      hoverable\n      onClick={handleCardClick}\n      role=\"button\"\n      tabIndex={0}\n      aria-label={&#96;View details for ${projectName || 'Untitled Project'}&#96;}\n      onKeyDown={e =\u003e { \n        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {\n          e.preventDefault();\n          handleCardClick();\n        }\n      }}\n    \u003e\n      {/* Cover Image with subtle project name overlay */}",

        "contents": "const JobDetailPage: React.FC =\n  ...\n  const loadJobDetails = async\n ...\n finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const incrementJobViews = async () =\u003e {\n    // Completely disable view tracking to eliminate Firebase connection errors\n    // This functionality is not critical for the user experience\n    return;\n  };\n\n  // Check if user has already saved this job\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    // Reset saved state when user or job changes\n    setIsSaved(false);\n    \n    if (auth.currentUser \u0026\u0026 jobId) {\n      const savedJobRef = doc(db, 'savedJobs', &#96;${auth.currentUser.uid}_${jobId}&#96;);\n      \n      // Use a more robust approach to check saved status\n      const checkSavedStatus = async () =\u003e {\n        try {\n          console.log('🔍 Checking saved status for user:', auth.currentUser?.uid, 'job:', jobId);\n          console.log('📄 Document path:', savedJobRef.path);\n          \n          const docSnap = await getDoc(savedJobRef);\n          const exists = docSnap.exists();\n          console.log('✅ Saved job exists:', exists);\n          setIsSaved(exists);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          console.error('❌ Error checking saved status:', error);\n          console.error('🔍 Error code:', error.code);\n          console.error('🔍 Error message:', error.message);\n          \n          // Don't show error to user, just assume not saved\n          setIsSaved(false);\n          \n          // Handle specific permission errors gracefully\n          if (error.code === 'permission-denied') {\n            console.log('⚠️ Permission denied for saved job check - this is expected for new users');\n          }\n        }\n      };\n      \n      checkSavedStatus();\n    }\n  }, [auth.currentUser, jobId]);",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  const getTimeAgo = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return '';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    const now = new Date();\n    const diffInHours = Math.floor((now.getTime() - dateObj.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60));\n    \n    if (diffInHours \u003c 1) return 'Just now';\n    if (diffInHours \u003c 24) return &#96;${diffInHours}h ago&#96;;\n    if (diffInHours \u003c 168) return &#96;${Math.floor(diffInHours / 24)}d ago&#96;;\n    return &#96;${Math.floor(diffInHours / 168)}w ago&#96;;\n  };\n\n  const getExperienceLevelColor = (level: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (level) {\n      case 'entry': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800';\n      case 'mid': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';\n      case 'senior': return 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800';\n      case 'executive': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800';\n      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getContractTypeColor = (type: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (type) {\n      case 'full_time': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';\n      case 'part_time': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800';\n      case 'contract': return 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800';\n      case 'freelance': return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800';\n      case 'internship': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800';\n      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';\n    }\n  };\n\n  if (isLoading) {\n    return (\n      \u003cdiv className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"text-center\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-gray-900 mx-auto mb-4\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003cp className=\"text-lg font-light text-gray-600\"\u003eLoading job details...\u003c/p\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    );\n  }",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "const JobDetailPage: React.FC =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  const handleShareJob = async () =\u003e {\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${window.location.origin}/jobs/${jobId}&#96;;\n    \n    if (navigator.share) {\n      try {\n        await navigator.share({\n          title: job?.title || 'Check out this job',\n          text: &#96;I found this great opportunity: ${job?.title}&#96;,\n          url: shareUrl\n        });\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // Don't log AbortError as it's just user cancellation\n        if (error.name !== 'AbortError') {\n          console.error('Error sharing:', error);\n        }\n      }\n    } else {\n      // Fallback to clipboard\n      try {\n        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(shareUrl);\n        toast.success('Job link copied to clipboard');\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error copying to clipboard:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to copy link');\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatSalary = (salary: { min?: number; max?: number; currency?: string } | undefined) =\u003e {\n    if (!salary || (salary.min === undefined \u0026\u0026 salary.max === undefined)) return 'Salary not specified';\n    const { min, max, currency = 'USD' } = salary;\n    if (min !== undefined \u0026\u0026 max !== undefined) {\n      if (min === max) {\n        return &#96;${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n      }\n      return &#96;${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()} - ${max.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n    } else if (min !== undefined) {\n      return &#96;From ${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n    } else if (max !== undefined) {\n      return &#96;Up to ${currency} ${max.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n    }\n    return 'Salary not specified';\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { \n      year: 'numeric', \n      month: 'short', \n      day: 'numeric' \n    });\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  const handleShareJob = async () =\u003e {\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${window.location.origin}/jobs/${jobId}&#96;;\n    \n    if (navigator.share) {\n      try {\n        await navigator.share({\n          title: job?.title || 'Check out this job',\n          text: &#96;I found this great opportunity: ${job?.title}&#96;,\n          url: shareUrl\n        });\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // Don't log AbortError as it's just user cancellation\n        if (error.name !== 'AbortError') {\n          console.error('Error sharing:', error);\n        }\n      }\n    } else {\n      // Fallback to clipboard\n      try {\n        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(shareUrl);\n        toast.success('Job link copied to clipboard');\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error copying to clipboard:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to copy link');\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatSalary = (salary: { min?: number; max?: number; currency?: string } | undefined) =\u003e {\n    if (!salary || (salary.min === undefined \u0026\u0026 salary.max === undefined)) return 'Salary not specified';\n    const { min, max, currency = 'USD' } = salary;\n    if (min !== undefined \u0026\u0026 max !== undefined) {\n      if (min === max) {\n        return &#96;${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n      }\n      return &#96;${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()} - ${max.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n    } else if (min !== undefined) {\n      return &#96;From ${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n    } else if (max !== undefined) {\n      return &#96;Up to ${currency} ${max.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n    }\n    return 'Salary not specified';\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { \n      year: 'numeric', \n      month: 'short', \n      day: 'numeric' \n    });\n  };",

      "contents": "import React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport { Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { JobPosting } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport { cn } from '../../lib/utils';\nimport Card, { CardHeader, CardBody, CardFooter, CardTitle, CardDescription } from '../ui/Card';\nimport { Button } from '../ui/Button';\nimport { Calendar, MapPin, Briefcase, Clock, DollarSign, Tag, ExternalLink, Bookmark, BookmarkCheck } from 'lucide-react';\n\ninterface JobCardProps {\n  job: JobPosting \u0026 { matchScore?: number };\n  onApply?: (jobId: string) =\u003e void;\n  onSave?: (jobId: string) =\u003e void;\n  showMatchScore?: boolean;\n  className?: string;\n}\n\nconst JobCard: React.FC\u003cJobCardProps\u003e = ({ \n  job, \n  onApply, \n  onSave, \n  showMatchScore = false,\n  className = ''\n}) =\u003e {\n  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(false);\n  const [isSaved, setIsSaved] = useState(false);\n  \n  // Format date to relative time\n  const formatRelativeTime = (date: Date | string | any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    \n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    const now = new Date();\n    const diffTime = Math.abs(now.getTime() - dateObj.getTime());\n    const diffDays = Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));\n    \n    if (diffDays === 0) return 'Today';\n    if (diffDays === 1) return '1 day ago';\n    if (diffDays \u003c 7) return &#96;${diffDays} days ago&#96;;\n    if (diffDays \u003c 30) return &#96;${Math.floor(diffDays / 7)} weeks ago&#96;;\n    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString();\n  };\n\n  // Format salary range\n  const formatSalary = (salary: { min: number; max: number; currency?: string } | undefined) =\u003e {\n    if (!salary) return 'Salary not specified';\n    const { min, max, currency = 'USD' } = salary;\n    if (min === max) return &#96;${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n    return &#96;${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()} - ${max.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n  };\n\n  // Get color classes based on match score\n  const getMatchScoreColor = (score: number) =\u003e {\n    if (score \u003e= 0.8) return 'bg-green-500 text-white';\n    if (score \u003e= 0.6) return 'bg-blue-500 text-white';\n    if (score \u003e= 0.4) return 'bg-yellow-500 text-white';\n    return 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-800';\n  };\n\n  // Get experience level display text and color\n  const getExperienceLevel = (level: string) =\u003e {\n    const levels: Record\u003cstring, { text: string; color: string }\u003e = {\n      entry: { text: 'Entry Level', color: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800' },\n      mid: { text: 'Mid Level', color: 'bg-green-100 text-green-800' },\n      senior: { text: 'Senior Level', color: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800' },\n      executive: { text: 'Executive', color: 'bg-red-100 text-red-800' },\n    };\n    return levels[level] || { text: level, color: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800' };\n  };\n\n  // Get contract type display text and color\n  const getContractType = (type: string) =\u003e {\n    const types: Record\u003cstring, { text: string; color: string }\u003e = {\n      full_time: { text: 'Full-time', color: 'bg-green-100 text-green-800' },\n      part_time: { text: 'Part-time', color: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800' },\n      contract: { text: 'Contract', color: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800' },\n      freelance: { text: 'Freelance', color: 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800' },\n      internship: { text: 'Internship', color: 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800' },\n    };\n    return types[type] || { text: type, color: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800' };\n  };\n\n  const handleSave = (e: React.MouseEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    setIsSaved(!isSaved);\n    onSave?.(job.id);\n  };\n\n  const handleApply = (e: React.MouseEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    onApply?.(job.id);\n  };\n\n  const experienceLevel = getExperienceLevel(job.experienceLevel || '');\n  const contractType = getContractType(job.contractType || '');\n  const postedDate = formatRelativeTime(job.postedAt);\n  const deadlineDate = job.deadline ? formatRelativeTime(job.deadline) : null;\n\n  return (\n    \u003cCard \n      variant=\"elevated\"\n      className={cn(\n        'overflow-hidden border border-gray-100',\n        'transition-all duration-200',\n        className\n      )}\n      hoverable\n    \u003e\n      \u003cCardHeader className=\"relative pb-4 border-b border-gray-100\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-start justify-between gap-4\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"flex-1 min-w-0\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center gap-2 mb-2\"\u003e\n              \u003ch3 className=\"text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 truncate\"\u003e\n                {job.title}\n              \u003c/h3\u003e\n              {job.isUrgent \u0026\u0026 (\n                \u003cspan className=\"inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-red-100 text-red-800\"\u003e\n                  Urgent\n                \u003c/span\u003e\n              )}\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n            \n            \u003cdiv className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-sm text-gray-600\"\u003e\n              \u003cspan className=\"flex items-center\"\u003e\n                \u003cBriefcase className=\"w-4 h-4 mr-1.5 text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0\" /\u003e\n                \u003cspan className=\"truncate\"\u003e{job.department}\u003c/span\u003e\n              \u003c/span\u003e\n              \u003cspan className=\"text-gray-300 hidden sm:inline\"\u003e•\u003c/span\u003e\n              \u003cspan className=\"flex items-center\"\u003e\n                \u003cMapPin className=\"w-4 h-4 mr-1.5 text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0\" /\u003e\n                \u003cspan className=\"truncate\"\u003e{job.location}\u003c/span\u003e\n              \u003c/span\u003e\n              {job.isRemote \u0026\u0026 (\n                \u003c\u003e\n                  \u003cspan className=\"text-gray-300 hidden sm:inline\"\u003e•\u003c/span\u003e\n                  \u003cspan className=\"inline-flex items-center text-blue-600\"\u003e\n                    \u003cspan className=\"w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-blue-400 mr-1.5\"\u003e\u003c/span\u003e\n                    Remote\n                  \u003c/span\u003e\n                \u003c/\u003e\n              )}\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n          \n          {onSave \u0026\u0026 (\n            \u003cbutton\n              type=\"button\"\n              className=\"h-8 w-8 rounded-full hover:bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-400 hover:text-blue-600 transition-colors\"\n              onClick={handleSave}\n              aria-label={isSaved ? 'Unsave job' : 'Save job'}\n            \u003e\n              {isSaved ? (\n                \u003cBookmarkCheck className=\"h-5 w-5 text-blue-600 fill-current\" /\u003e\n              ) : (\n                \u003cBookmark className=\"h-5 w-5\" /\u003e\n              )}\n            \u003c/button\u003e\n          )}\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n        \n        {/* Match score */}\n        {showMatchScore \u0026\u0026 job.matchScore !== undefined \u0026\u0026 (\n          \u003cdiv className=\"absolute -top-2 -right-2\"\u003e\n            \u003cspan className={cn(\n              'inline-flex items-center text-xs font-medium px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full shadow-sm',\n              getMatchScoreColor(job.matchScore)\n            )}\u003e\n              {Math.round(job.matchScore * 100)}% Match\n            \u003c/span\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        )}\n      \u003c/CardHeader\u003e\n      \n      \u003cCardBody className=\"py-4\"\u003e\n        {/* Description */}\n        \u003cp className=\"text-gray-600 mb-5 line-clamp-3\"\u003e\n experienceLevel: 'intern' | 'entry' | 'associate' | 'mid' | 'senior' | 'lead' | 'manager' | 'director' | 'executive';\n  isRemote: boolean;\n  \n  // Details\n  description: string;\n  requirements: 'documentary' | 'other';\n  \n  // Timeline\n  startDate: string;\n  endDate?: string;\n  deadline?: string;\n  \n  // Contact\n  contactName: string;\n  contactEmail: string;\n  contactPhone?: string;\n  \n  // Additional\n  isPaid: boolean;\n  isUnion: boolean;\n  visaSponsorship: boolean;\n  relocationAssistance: boolean;\n}\n\n// Extend the base interface for Firestore\nexport interface FirestoreJobPosting extends JobPostingBase {\n  id?: string;\n  createdAt: Timestamp | FieldValue;\n  updatedAt: Timestamp | FieldValue;\n  status: 'draft' | 'published' | 'closed' | 'archived';\n  postedById: string;\n  createdBy: string; // Added for tracking who created the job\n  applicationCount: number;\n  views: number;\n}\n\n// Extend the base interface for the app (with Date instead of Timestamp)\nexport interface JobPosting extends JobPostingBase {\n  id?: string;\n  createdAt: Date;\n  updatedAt: Date;\n  status: 'draft' | 'published' | 'closed' | 'archived';\n  postedById: string;\n  createdBy: string; // Added for tracking who created the job\n  applicationCount: number;\n  views: number;\n}\n\n\n\n// Create a new job posting\nexport const createJobPosting = async (\n  jobData: Omit\u003cJobPostingBase, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt' | 'status' | 'postedById' | 'applicationCount' | 'views'\u003e,\n  userId: string\n): Promise\u003cstring\u003e =\u003e {\n  try {\n  \n    \n    const jobPosting: Omit\u003cFirestoreJobPosting, 'id'\u003e = {\n      ...jobData,\n      status: 'published',\n      postedById: userId, // Ensure this is set from the function parameter\n      createdBy: userId,  // Also set createdBy for backward compatibility\n      applicationCount: 0,\n      views: 0,\n      createdAt: serverTimestamp(),\n      updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),\n    };\n\n    const docRef = await addDoc(collection(db, 'jobPostings'), jobPosting);\n    return docRef.id;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error creating job posting:', error);\n    throw new Error('Failed to create job posting');\n  }\n};\n\n// Update an existing job posting\nexport const updateJobPosting = async (jobId: string, jobData: Partial\u003cJobPostingBase\u003e): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e =\u003e {\n  try {\n    const jobRef = doc(db, 'jobPostings', jobId);\n    const updateData: Partial\u003cFirestoreJobPosting\u003e = {\n      ...jobData,\n      updatedAt: serverTimestamp()\n    };\n    \n    await updateDoc(jobRef, updateData);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error updating job posting:', error);\n    throw new Error('Failed to update job posting');\n  }\n};\n\n// Delete a job posting\nexport const deleteJobPosting = async (jobId: string): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e =\u003e {\n  try {\n    const jobRef = doc(db, 'jobPostings', jobId);\n    await deleteDoc(jobRef);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error deleting job posting:', error);\n    throw new Error('Failed to delete job posting');\n  }\n};\n\n// Status type that includes 'all' for unfiltered queries\ntype JobStatus = 'draft' | 'published' | 'closed' | 'archived' | 'all';\n\n// Get job postings with filters\nexport const getJobPostings = async (filters: {\n  status?: JobStatus;\n  department?: string;\n  jobType?: string;\n  experienceLevel?: string;\n  isRemote?: boolean;\n  postedBy?: string;\n  limit?: number;\n} = {}): Promise\u003cJobPosting[]\u003e =\u003e {\n  try {\n\n    \n    const jobsRef = collection(db, 'jobPostings');\n\n    \n    let q = query(jobsRef);\n\n    \n    // Apply status filter if provided and not 'all'\n    if (filters.status \u0026\u0026 filters.status !== 'all') {\n\n      q = query(q, where('status', '==', filters.status));\n    } else if (!filters.status) {\n      // Default to published if no status is specified\n\n      q = query(q, where('status', '==', 'published'));\n    } else {\n\n    }\n    \n    if (filters?.department) {\n\n      q = query(q, where('department', '==', filters.department));\n    }\n    \n    if (filters?.jobType) {\n\n      q = query(q, where('jobType', '==', filters.jobType));\n    }\n    \n    if (filters?.experienceLevel) {\n\n      q = query(q, where('experienceLevel', '==', filters.experienceLevel));\n    }\n    \n    if (filters?.isRemote !== undefined) {\n\n      q = query(q, where('isRemote', '==', filters.isRemote));\n    }\n    \n    if (filters?.postedBy) {\n\n      if (filters.postedBy) {\n        q = query(q, where('postedById', '==', filters.postedBy));\n      }\n    }\n    \n    if (filters?.limit) {\n\n      q = query(q, limit(filters.limit));\n    }\n    \n    // Order by creation date, newest first\n\n    q = query(q, orderBy('createdAt', 'desc'));\n    \n\n    const querySnapshot = await getDocs(q);\n\n    \n    const jobs: JobPosting[] = [];\n    \n    querySnapshot.forEach((doc) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const docData = doc.data();\n        // Ensure required fields exist with defaults\n        const jobData: JobPosting = {\n          id: doc.id,\n          title: docData.title || 'Untitled Position',\n          department: docData.department || 'General',\n          location: docData.benefits || '',\n          skills: Array.isArray(docData.skills) ? docData.skills : [],\n          salaryMin: docData.salaryMin,\n          salaryMax: docData.salaryMax,\n          salaryPeriod: docData.salaryPeriod || 'year',\n          showSalary: docData.showSalary || false,\n          projectName: docData.projectName || '',\n          projectType: docData.projectType || 'other',\n          startDate: docData.startDate || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],\n          contactName: docData.contactName || '',\n          contactEmail: docData.contactEmail || '',\n          isPaid: docData.isPaid !== undefined ? docData.isPaid : true,\n          isUnion: docData.isUnion || false,\n          visaSponsorship: docData.visaSponsorship || false,\n          relocationAssistance: docData.relocationAssistance || false,\n          status: docData.status || 'draft',\n          postedById: docData.postedById || '',\n          createdBy: docData.createdBy || docData.postedById || '',\n          applicationCount: docData.applicationCount || 0,\n          views: docData.views || 0,\n          // Handle Firestore timestamps\n          createdAt: docData.createdAt?.toDate ? docData.createdAt.toDate() : new Date(),\n          updatedAt: docData.updatedAt?.toDate ? docData.updatedAt.toDate() : new Date()\n        };\n\n        \n        jobs.push(jobData);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error(&#96;Error processing document ${doc.id}:&#96;, error);\n      }\n    });\n    \n\n    return jobs;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error getting job postings:', error);\n    throw new Error('Failed to get job postings');\n  }\n};\n\n// Get a single job posting by ID\nexport const getJobPostingById = async (jobId: string): Promise\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e =\u003e {\n  try {\n    const docRef = doc(db, 'jobPostings', jobId);\n    const docSnap = await getDoc(docRef);\n    \n    if (!docSnap.exists()) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    \n    const docData = docSnap.data();\n    \n    // Return the job data with proper typing\n    return {\n      ...docData as JobPostingBase,\n      id: jobId,\n      createdAt: docData.createdAt?.toDate ? docData.createdAt.toDate() : new Date(),\n      updatedAt: docData.updatedAt?.toDate ? docData.updatedAt.toDate() : new Date(),\n      status: docData.status || 'published',\n      postedById: docData.postedById || '',\n      createdBy: docData.createdBy || docData.postedById || '',\n      applicationCount: docData.applicationCount || 0,\n      views: docData.views || 0,\n      skills: Array.isArray(docData.skills) ? docData.skills : []\n    };\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching job posting:', error);\n    throw new Error('Failed to fetch job posting');\n  }\n};\n",

        "contents": "const JobDetailPage: React.FC =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  const handleShareJob = async () =\u003e {\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${window.location.origin}/jobs/${jobId}&#96;;\n    \n    if (navigator.share) {\n      try {\n        await navigator.share({\n          title: job?.title || 'Check out this job',\n          text: &#96;I found this great opportunity: ${job?.title}&#96;,\n          url: shareUrl\n        });\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // Don't log AbortError as it's just user cancellation\n        if (error.name !== 'AbortError') {\n          console.error('Error sharing:', error);\n        }\n      }\n    } else {\n      // Fallback to clipboard\n      try {\n        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(shareUrl);\n        toast.success('Job link copied to clipboard');\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error copying to clipboard:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to copy link');\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatSalary = (salary: { min?: number; max?: number; currency?: string } | undefined) =\u003e {\n    if (!salary || (salary.min === undefined \u0026\u0026 salary.max === undefined)) return 'Salary not specified';\n    const { min, max, currency = 'USD' } = salary;\n    if (min !== undefined \u0026\u0026 max !== undefined) {\n      if (min === max) {\n        return &#96;${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n      }\n      return &#96;${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()} - ${max.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n    } else if (min !== undefined) {\n      return &#96;From ${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n    } else if (max !== undefined) {\n      return &#96;Up to ${currency} ${max.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n    }\n    return 'Salary not specified';\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { \n      year: 'numeric', \n      month: 'short', \n      day: 'numeric' \n    });\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  const handleShareJob = async () =\u003e {\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${window.location.origin}/jobs/${jobId}&#96;;\n    \n    if (navigator.share) {\n      try {\n        await navigator.share({\n          title: job?.title || 'Check out this job',\n          text: &#96;I found this great opportunity: ${job?.title}&#96;,\n          url: shareUrl\n        });\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // Don't log AbortError as it's just user cancellation\n        if (error.name !== 'AbortError') {\n          console.error('Error sharing:', error);\n        }\n      }\n    } else {\n      // Fallback to clipboard\n      try {\n        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(shareUrl);\n        toast.success('Job link copied to clipboard');\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error copying to clipboard:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to copy link');\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatSalary = (salary: { min?: number; max?: number; currency?: string } | undefined) =\u003e {\n    if (!salary || (salary.min === undefined \u0026\u0026 salary.max === undefined)) return 'Salary not specified';\n    const { min, max, currency = 'USD' } = salary;\n    if (min !== undefined \u0026\u0026 max !== undefined) {\n      if (min === max) {\n        return &#96;${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n      }\n      return &#96;${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()} - ${max.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n    } else if (min !== undefined) {\n      return &#96;From ${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n    } else if (max !== undefined) {\n      return &#96;Up to ${currency} ${max.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n    }\n    return 'Salary not specified';\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { \n      year: 'numeric', \n      month: 'short', \n      day: 'numeric' \n    });\n  };",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "const PostJobPage: React.FC =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  // Handle select changes - consolidated implementation\n  const handleSelectChange = (name: keyof JobFormData) =\u003e (option: SingleValue\u003cSelectOption\u003e) =\u003e {\n    if (option) {\n      setFormData(prev =\u003e ({\n        ...prev,\n        [name]: option.value\n      }));\n    }\n    \n    // Clear error for the field being edited\n    if (errors[name]) {\n      setErrors(prev =\u003e ({\n        ...prev,\n        [name]: undefined\n      }));\n    }\n    \n    // Clear error for the field being edited\n    if (errors[name]) {\n      setErrors(prev =\u003e ({\n        ...prev,\n        [name]: undefined\n      }));\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent\u003cHTMLFormElement\u003e): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    \n    // First validate all fields\n    const isValid = validateForm();\n    \n    if (!isValid) {\n      // Find the first error and scroll to it\n      const firstError = Object.keys(errors).find(key =\u003e errors[key as keyof FormErrors]);\n      if (firstError) {\n        const element = document.querySelector(&#96;[name=\"${firstError}\"]&#96;);\n        if (element) {\n          element.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });\n        }\n      } else {\n        // If no specific field error but form is invalid, show general error\n        toast.error('Please fill in all required fields');\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n    \n    if (!currentUser) {\n      const errorMsg = 'You must be logged in to post a job';\n      console.error(errorMsg);\n      toast.error(errorMsg);\n      return;\n    }\n    \n    setIsSubmitting(true);",

const JobCard: React.FC&lt;JobCardProps&gt; = ({ job, currentUserId, onEdit }) =&gt; {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [isHovered, setIsHovered] = useState(false);
  const [isSaved, setIsSaved] = useState(false);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const { currentUser } = useAuth();
  
  // Check if job is saved on component mount
  useEffect(() =&gt; {
    const checkSavedStatus = async () =&gt; {
      if (!currentUser) return;
      
      try {
        const { saved } = await SavedJobsService.isJobSaved(currentUser.uid, job.id);
        setIsSaved(saved);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error checking saved status:', error);
        // Don't show error to user, just assume not saved
        setIsSaved(false);
      }
    };
    
    checkSavedStatus();
  }, [currentUser, job.id]);

  const handleSave = async (e: React.MouseEvent) =&gt; {
    e.stopPropagation();
    
    if (!currentUser) {
      toast.error('Please log in to save jobs');
      return;
    }
    
    if (isSaving) return; // Prevent double-clicks
    
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      if (isSaved) {
        // Remove from saved
        const { savedJobId } = await SavedJobsService.isJobSaved(currentUser.uid, job.id);
        if (savedJobId) {
          await SavedJobsService.removeSavedJob(savedJobId);
          setIsSaved(false);
          toast.success('Job removed from saved');
        }
      } else {
        // Add to saved
        await SavedJobsService.saveJob(currentUser.uid, job.id);
        setIsSaved(true);
        toast.success('Job saved successfully');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error saving job:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to save job. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }

## **Improvement 1 Complete: "Save Job" Button Added to Job Cards and Details** ✅

   - Added loading states and error handling

   - Added proper TypeScript type safety

2. **Enhanced JobsPage JobCard** (`src/pages/JobsPage.tsx`):
   - Added save functionality to the local JobCard component
   - Added proper imports for Bookmark icons and SavedJobsService

   - Maintained existing edit functionality for job posters

3. **Enhanced JobDetailPage** (`src/components/JobSearch/JobDetailPage.tsx`):
   - Updated to use `SavedJobsService` consistently
   - Improved error handling and user feedback
   - Maintained existing functionality

### **Key Features:**
- ✅ Save/unsave jobs with visual feedback
- ✅ Loading states to prevent double-clicks
- ✅ Toast notifications for user feedback
- ✅ Proper error handling
- ✅ TypeScript type safety
- ✅ Consistent UI across all job cards
- ✅ Works on both job cards and job detail pages

### **User Experience:**
- Users can now save jobs from any job card or job detail page
- Clear visual indicators show saved/unsaved state
- Instant feedback with toast notifications
- Smooth loading states prevent confusion

  });\n  };\n\n  const getTimeAgo = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return '';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    const now = new Date();\n    const       "contents": "import React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport { SocialService } from '../../utilities/socialService';\nimport runSocialSystemTest from '../../utilities/socialTestData';\nimport { collection, query, where, getDocs } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\n\ninterface SocialTestPageProps {\n  currentUserId: string;\n  currentUserName: string;\n  currentUserAvatar?: string;\n}\n\nconst SocialTestPage: React.FC\u003cSocialTestPageProps\u003e = ({ \n  currentUserId, \n  currentUserName,\n  currentUserAvatar \n}) =\u003e {\n  const [testResults, setTestResults] = useState\u003cstring[]\u003e([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const addResult = (message: string) =\u003e {\n    setTestResults(prev =\u003e [...prev, &#96;${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}: ${message}&#96;]);\n  };\n\n  const runTests = async () =\u003e {\n    setLoading(true);\n    setTestResults([]);\n    \n    try {\n      addResult('🧪 Starting social system tests...');\n      \n      // Test 1: Check if SocialService methods exist\n      addResult('Testing SocialService methods...');\n      const methods = [\n        'sendFollowRequest',\n        'getFollowRequest', \n        'respondToFollowRequest',\n        'getFollow',\n        'unfollow',\n        'getFollowStatus',\n        'getFollowersCount',\n        'getFollowingCount'\n      ];\n      \n      methods.forEach(method =\u003e {\n        if (typeof (SocialService as any)[method] === 'function') {\n          addResult(&#96;✅ ${method} method exists&#96;);\n        } else {\n          addResult(&#96;❌ ${method} method missing&#96;);\n        }\n      });\n      \n      // Test 2: Create test data\n      addResult('Creating test data...');\n      await runSocialSystemTest();\n      addResult('✅ Test data created successfully');\n      \n      // Test 3: Test follow status check\n      addResult('Testing follow status check...');\n      const status = await SocialService.getFollowStatus(currentUserId, 'test-user-1');\n      addResult(&#96;✅ Follow status check: ${status}&#96;);\n      \n      // Test 4: Test followers count\n      addResult('Testing followers count...');\n      const count = await SocialService.getFollowersCount(currentUserId);\n      addResult(&#96;✅ Followers count: ${count}&#96;);\n      \n      // Test 5: Test sending follow request and notification\n      addResult('Testing follow request and notification...');\n      try {\n        await SocialService.sendFollowRequest(currentUserId, 'test-user-1', 'Test follow request');\n        addResult('✅ Follow request sent successfully');\n        \n        // Check if notification was created\n        setTimeout(async () =\u003e {\n          const notificationsQuery = query(\n            collection(db, 'notifications'),\n            where('userId', '==', 'test-user-1'),\n            where('type', '==', 'follow_request')\n          );\n          const snapshot = await getDocs(notificationsQuery);\n          if (!snapshot.empty) {\n            addResult(&#96;✅ Notification created: ${snapshot.docs[0].id}&#96;);\n          } else {\n            addResult('❌ No notification found');\n          }\n        }, 2000);\n        \n      } catch (error) {\n        addResult(&#96;❌ Follow request failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}&#96;);\n      }\n      \n      addResult('🎉 All tests completed successfully!');\n      \n    } catch (error) {\n      addResult(&#96;❌ Test failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}&#96;);\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const testNotificationCreation = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUserId) {\n      toast.error('Please log in first');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      console.log('[SocialTestPage] Testing notification creation for user:', currentUserId);\n      \n      // Create a test notification\n      await SocialService.createNotification({\n        userId: currentUserId,\n        type: 'follow_request',\n        title: 'Test Follow Request',\n        message: 'This is a test notification to verify the system is working',\n        relatedUserId: 'test-user-id',\n        isRead: false,\n        createdAt: new Date(),\n        actionUrl: '/social'\n      });\n      \n      console.log('[SocialTestPage] Test notification created successfully');\n      toast.success('Test notification created! Check your notification bell.');\n      \n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[SocialTestPage] Error creating test notification:', error);\n      toast.error('Error creating test notification: ' + error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const testFollowRequestWithNotification = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUserId) {\n      toast.error('Please log in first');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      console.log('[SocialTestPage] Testing follow request with notification');\n      \n      // Create a test user ID (this would normally be a real user)\n      const testTargetUserId = 'test-target-user-' + Date.now();\n      \n      // Send follow request (this should create a notification)\n      await SocialService.sendFollowRequest(currentUserId, testTargetUserId, 'Test follow request');\n      \n      console.log('[SocialTestPage] Test follow request sent successfully');\n      toast.success('Test follow request sent! Check the console for logs.');\n      \n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[SocialTestPage] Error sending test follow request:', error);\n      toast.error('Error sending test follow request: ' + error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const testActivityFeedWithLikesAndComments = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUserId) {\n      toast.error('Please log in first');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      console.log('[SocialTestPage] Testing activity feed with likes and comments');\n      \n      // Create a test activity feed item\n      await SocialService.createActivityFeedItem({\n        userId: currentUserId,\n        type: 'project_created',\n        title: 'Test Project Created',\n        description: 'This is a test activity to verify like and comment functionality',\n        likes: 0,\n        comments: 0,\n        createdAt: new Date(),\n        isPublic: true\n      });\n      \n      console.log('[SocialTestPage] Test activity created successfully');\n      toast.success('Test activity created! Check the activity feed to test likes and comments.');\n      \n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[SocialTestPage] Error creating test activity:', error);\n      toast.error('Error creating test activity: ' + error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const testLikeAndCommentFunctionality = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUserId) {\n      toast.error('Please log in first');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      console.log('[SocialTestPage] Testing like and comment functionality');\n      \n      // Get the first activity from the feed\n      const activities = await SocialService.getActivityFeed(currentUserId, 1);\n      if (activities.length === 0) {\n        toast.error('No activities found. Create an activity first.');\n        return;\n      }\n      \n      const activity = activities[0];\n      \n      // Test liking the activity\n      await SocialService.likeActivity(activity.id, currentUserId, currentUserName);\n      console.log('[SocialTestPage] Activity liked successfully');\n      \n      // Test adding a comment\n      await SocialService.addComment(activity.id, currentUserId, currentUserName, currentUserAvatar, 'This is a test comment!');\n      console.log('[SocialTestPage] Comment added successfully');\n      \n      toast.success('Like and comment functionality tested successfully!       "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { JobPosting } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport { cn } from '../../lib/utils';\nimport Card, { CardHeader, CardBody, CardFooter, CardTitle, CardDescription } from '../ui/Card';\nimport { Button } from '../ui/Button';\nimport { Calendar, MapPin, Briefcase, Clock, DollarSign, Tag, ExternalLink, Bookmark, BookmarkCheck } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { SavedJobsService } from '../../utilities/savedJobsService';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\n\ninterface JobCardProps {\n  job: JobPosting \u0026 { matchScore?: number };\n  onApply?: (jobId: string) =\u003e void;\n  onSave?: (jobId: string) =\u003e void;\n  showMatchScore?: boolean;\n  className?: string;\n  showSaveButton?: boolean;\n}\n\nconst JobCard: React.FC\u003cJobCardProps\u003e = ({ \n  job, \n  onApply, \n  onSave, \n  showMatchScore = false,\n  className = '',\n  showSaveButton = true\n}) =\u003e {\n  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(false);\n  const [isSaved, setIsSaved] = useState(false);\n  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  \n  // Check if job is saved on component mount\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const checkSavedStatus = async () =\u003e {\n      if (!currentUser || !showSaveButton || !job.id) return;\n      \n      try {\n        const { saved } = await SavedJobsService.isJobSaved(currentUser.uid, job.id);\n        setIsSaved(saved);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error checking saved status:', error);\n        // Don't show error to user, just assume not saved\n        setIsSaved(false);\n      }\n    };\n    \n    checkSavedStatus();\n  }, [currentUser, job.id, showSaveButton]);\n\n  // Format date to relative time\n  const formatRelativeTime = (date: Date | string | any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    \n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    const now = new Date();\n    const diffTime = Math.abs(now.getTime() - dateObj.getTime());\n    const diffDays = Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));\n    \n    if (diffDays === 0) return 'Today';\n    if (diffDays === 1) return '1 day ago';\n    if (diffDays \u003c 7) return &#96;${diffDays} days ago&#96;;\n    if (diffDays \u003c 30) return &#96;${Math.floor(diffDays / 7)} weeks ago&#96;;\n    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString();\n  };\n\n  // Format salary range\n  const formatSalary = (salary: { min: number; max: number; currency?: string } | undefined) =\u003e {\n    if (!salary) return 'Salary not specified';\n    const { min, max, currency = 'USD' } = salary;\n    if (min === max) return &#96;${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n    return &#96;${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()} - ${max.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n  };\n\n  // Get color classes based on match score\n  const getMatchScoreColor = (score: number) =\u003e {\n    if (score \u003e= 0.8) return 'bg-green-500 text-white';\n    if (score \u003e= 0.6) return 'bg-blue-500 text-white';\n    if (score \u003e= 0.4) return 'bg-yellow-500 text-white';\n    return 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-800';\n  };\n\n  // Get experience level display text and color\n  const getExperienceLevel = (level: string) =\u003e {\n    const levels: Record\u003cstring, { text: string; color: string }\u003e = {\n      entry: { text: 'Entry Level', color: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800' },\n      mid: { text: 'Mid Level', color: 'bg-green-100 text-green-800' },\n      senior: { text: 'Senior Level', color: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800' },\n      executive: { text: 'Executive', color: 'bg-red-100 text-red-800' },\n    };\n    return levels[level] || { text: level, color: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800' };\n  };\n\n  // Get contract type display text and color\n  const getContractType = (type: string) =\u003e {\n    const types: Record\u003cstring, { text: string; color: string }\u003e = {\n      full_time: { text: 'Full-time', color: 'bg-green-100 text-green-800' },\n      part_time: { text: 'Part-time', color: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800' },\n      contract: { text: 'Contract', color: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800' },\n      freelance: { text: 'Freelance', color: 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800' },\n      internship: { text: 'Internship', color: 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800' },\n    };\n    return types[type] || { text: type, color: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800' };\n  };\n\n  const handleSave = async (e: React.MouseEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    \n    if (!currentUser) {\n      toast.error('Please log in to save jobs');\n      return;\n    }\n    \n    if (!job.id) {\n      toast.error('Invalid job data');\n      return;\n    }\n    \n    if (isSaving) return; // Prevent double-clicks\n    \n    setIsSaving(true);\n    try {\n      if (isSaved) {\n        // Remove from saved\n        const { savedJobId } = await SavedJobsService.isJobSaved(currentUser.uid, job.id);\n        if (savedJobId) {\n          await SavedJobsService.removeSavedJob(savedJobId);\n          setIsSaved(false);\n          toast.success('Job removed from saved');\n        }\n      } else {\n        // Add to saved\n        await SavedJobsService.saveJob(currentUser.uid, job.id);\n        setIsSaved(true);\n        toast.success('Job saved successfully');\n      }\n      \n      // Call parent onSave callback if provided\n      onSave?.(job.id);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error saving job:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to save job. Please try again.');\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleApply = (e: React.MouseEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    onApply?.(job.id);\n  };\n\n  const experienceLevel = getExperienceLevel(job.experienceLevel || '');\n  const contractType = getContractType(job.contractType || '');\n  const postedDate = formatRelativeTime(job.postedAt);\n  const deadlineDate = job.deadline ? formatRelativeTime(job.deadline) : null;\n\n  return (\n    \u003cCard \n      variant=\"elevated\"\n      className={cn(\n        'overflow-hidden border border-gray-100',\n        'transition-all duration-200',\n        className\n      )}\n      hoverable\n    \u003e\n      \u003cCardHeader className=\"relative pb-4 border-b border-gray-100\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-start justify-between gap-4\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"flex-1 min-w-0\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center gap-2 mb-2\"\u003e\n              \u003ch3 className=\"text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 truncate\"\u003e\n                {job.title}\n              \u003c/h3\u003e\n              {job.isUrgent \u0026\u0026 (\n                \u003cspan className=\"inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-red-100 text-red-800\"\u003e\n                  Urgent\n                \u003c/span\u003e\n              )}\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n            \n            \u003cdiv className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-sm text-gray-600\"\u003e\n              \u003cspan className=\"flex items-center\"\u003e\n                \u003cBriefcase className=\"w-4 h-4 mr-1.5 text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0\" /\u003e\n                \u003cspan className=\"truncate\"\u003e{job.department}\u003c/span\u003e\n              \u003c/span\u003e\n              \u003cspan className=\"text-gray-300 hidden sm:inline\"\u003e•\u003c/span\u003e\n              \u003cspan className=\"flex items-center\"\u003e\n                \u003cMapPin className=\"w-4 h-4 mr-1.5 text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0\" /\u003e\n                \u003cspan className=\"truncate\"\u003e{job.location}\u003c/span\u003e\n              \u003c/span\u003e\n              {job.isRemote \u0026\u0026 (\n                \u003c\u003e\n                  \u003cspan className=\"text-gray-300 hidden sm:inline\"\u003e•\u003c/span\u003e\n                  \u003cspan className=\"inline-flex items-center text-blue-600\"\u003e\n                    \u003cspan className=\"w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-blue-400 mr-1.5\"\u003e\u003c/span\u003e\n                    Remote\n                  \u003c/span\u003e\n                \u003c/\u003e\n              )}\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n          \n          {showSaveButton \u0026\u0026 currentUser \u0026\u0026 (\n            \u003cbutton\n              type=\"button\"\n              className={cn(\n                \"h-8 w-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-colors\",\n                isSaving ? \"opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed\" : \"hover:bg-gray-50\",\n                isSaved \n                  ? \"text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-700\" \n                  : \"text-gray-400 hover:text-blue-600\"\n              )}\n              onClick={handleSave}\n              disabled={isSaving}\n              aria-label={isSaved ? 'Unsave job' : 'Save job'}\n              title={isSaved ? 'Remove from saved jobs' : 'Save job for later'}\n            \u003e\n              {isSaving ? (\n                \u003cdiv className=\"animate-spin rounded-full h-4 w-4 border-b-2 border-current\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n              ) : isSaved ? (\n                \u003cBookmarkCheck className=\"h-5 w-5 fill-current\" /\u003e\n              ) : (\n                \u003cBookmark className=\"h-5 w-5\" /\u003e\n              )}\n            \u003c/button\u003e\n          )}\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n        \n        {/* Match score */}\n        {showMatchScore \u0026\u0026 job.matchScore !== undefined \u0026\u0026 (\n          \u003cdiv className=\"absolute -top-2 -right-2\"\u003e\n            \u003cspan className={cn(\n              'inline-flex items-center text-xs font-medium px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full shadow-sm',\n              getMatchScoreColor(job.matchScore)\n            )}\u003e\n              {Math.round(job.matchScore * 100)}% Match\n            \u003c/span\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        )}\n      \u003c/CardHeader\u003e\n      \n      \u003cCardBody className=\"py-4\"\u003e\n        {/* Description */}\n        \u003cp className=\"text-gray-600 mb-5 line-clamp-3\"\u003e\n          {job.description}\n        \u003c/p\u003e\n        \n        {/* Details */}\n        \u003cdiv className=\"grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-4 text-sm\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-start\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"bg-blue-50 p-1.5 rounded-md mr-3 flex-shrink-0\"\u003e\n              \u003cDollarSign className=\"w-4 h-4 text-blue-600\" mb-0.5\"\u003eSalary\u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003cdiv className=\"text-gray-900\"\u003e{formatSalary(job.salary)}\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n          \n          \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-start\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"bg-blue-50 p-1.5 rounded-md mr-3 flex-shrink-0\"\u003e\n              \u003cCalendar className=\"w-4 h-4 text-blue-600\" /\u003e\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003cdiv\u003e\n              \u003cdiv className=\"font-medium text-gray-500 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider mb-0.5\"\u003ePosted\u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003cdiv className=\"text-gray-900\"\u003e{postedDate}\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n          \n          \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-start\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"bg-blue-50 p-1.5 rounded-md mr-3 flex-shrink-0\"\u003e\n              \u003cClock className=\"w-4 h-4 mb-0.5\"\u003eType\u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003cspan className={cn('inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium', contractType.color)}\u003e\n                {contractType.text}\n              \u003c/span\u003e\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n          \n          \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-start\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"bg-blue-50 p-1.5 rounded-md mr-3 flex-shrink-0\"\u003e\n              \u003cBriefcase className=\"w-4 h-4 text-blue-600\" /\u003e\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n
